plan.name: Share acceptance analysis and retained check authority
plan.summary: Replace the two Go declaration walks with one reusable analysis and explicit legacy and native policies, and define the four acceptance frameworks once for source display, structural validation, owner language, declaration dispatch and default adapters. Preserve all currently admitted and refused behavior, including permissive legacy declarations and unchanged hashes and locks, strict native signatures selected by the selector, package ambiguity checks, verbatim non-Go sources, trusted overrides and every existing adapter command, evidence, isolation and deadline contract. Remove checkBuild.repo and the redundant Original assignment in formalize.Plan: registration retains the repository only in sandbox.Original, uses plan presence to distinguish planning from building even when both retain originals, and preserves copied authority, child-request restrictions, shared budgets and ownership through cleanup. Extend the existing formalizer fixtures to exercise empty and conflicting initial Original values while keeping their GateServer flag parsing, candidate edits, opaque pytest-wrapper refusal and fresh final-check assertions, document the shared structural policies and retained path in docs/factory.md, and run the affected plumbing/formalize suites plus shuffled repeated queue tests and race checks. This is the complete internal refactor for step 2 of parent #510, with no framework rollout or external intake change; the merger records the implementation reuse decision under D-0105, D-0107, D-0301, D-0303, D-0311, D-0314, D-0316 and D-0317 without changing existing ratified plans or locks.

tests.name: TestSharedGoDeclarationPolicies668
tests.says: One reusable Go declaration analysis serves legacy and native validation without changing their distinct signature, import, duplicate-name, selector, hash or lock rules.

tests.name: TestSharedFrameworkDefinitions668
tests.says: Shared definitions for Go, pytest, Vitest and Jest retain source display, structural and owner checks, declaration dispatch, literal adapter selections and trusted overrides without treating structural admission as runtime support.

tests.name: TestRetainedQueueRegistrationModes668
tests.says: A nil-plan registration checks drafts against its retained Original while a registration with a plan runs builds, with copied authority and cross-mode refusal even when both retain original repositories.
